activity_summary: Alone, you went back over the cheerful sizes and the near five pounds you did not say. You repeated the afternoon, the scrap put away, and the three refusals. You stopped on the decision not to correct him.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said what he had not said in the shop, and stopped.

facets.activity: Did not say the near five pounds

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Remember: I did not correct him.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I had the true size in my mouth, near five pounds, and I did not give it to him.
